missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Середина' stays in the nominative case as the subject of 'была'. 'Дороги' is the genitive modifier, and 'пустой' is the instrumental predicate adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Середину' is the accusative direct object of the imperative 'найди'. 'Комнаты' is the genitive modifier naming what the middle belongs to.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Середины' is genitive after 'до' to mark the point reached. 'Пути' is the genitive modifier, and 'дошли' is the past-tense verb.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В середине' uses the prepositional form 'середине' after 'в' to mark where the table stands. 'Зала' is the genitive modifier.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Серединой' is in the instrumental case after 'над' to mark the space above. 'Стола' is the genitive modifier, and 'лампа' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Середине' is in the dative case after 'к' to mean by the middle of. 'Дня' is the genitive modifier, and 'стало жарко' describes the change.

missions.phrase: Он сел прямо на середину дивана.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative of destination. 'Середину' is the accusative after 'на' showing movement onto a spot. 'Дивана' is the genitive modifier, and 'прямо' adds emphasis.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Середины' is genitive after 'из' to mark the source. 'Толпы' is the genitive modifier, and 'крик' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Середины' is the nominative plural subject of 'порваны'. 'Обе' agrees in the feminine plural, and 'страниц' is the genitive plural modifier.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Середине' is dative after 'к' to show the target position. 'Вазу' is the accusative object, and 'ближе' marks relative nearness.
